## Features

AVENIQ web development packages include comprehensive engineering features focused on performance, accessibility, and management:

- **Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & Static Site Generation (SSG)**: Powered by Next.js for maximum performance, rapid initial page loads, and superior search engine indexing.
- **Responsive & Adaptive UI**: Built with Tailwind CSS and modern CSS layouts to ensure consistent visual aesthetics across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
- **Type-Safe Full-Stack Codebase**: Engineered with TypeScript across both client and server code to prevent runtime errors and streamline maintenance.
- **Headless CMS & Content Management Integration**: Seamless integration with platforms like Supabase or custom admin dashboards allowing non-technical team members to manage content easily.
- **Custom Form & Lead Processing**: Interactive forms equipped with client and server-side validation, anti-spam mechanisms, and direct CRM workflow triggers.
- **Core Web Vitals Optimization**: Automated image optimization, code splitting, lazy loading, and asset minification to score top ratings on Google Web Vitals metrics.
- **Multi-Language & Localization Support**: Internationalization (i18n) setup allowing global businesses to serve localized content across multiple regions.
- **Analytics & Conversion Tracking Setup**: Clean integration of privacy-focused event tracking, analytics dashboards, and tag management systems.
